disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to obtain or renew a license by bribery, fraudulent misrepresentation, or known board error
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempting to obtain, obtaining, renewing, or attempting to renew a license or other authorization to practice medicine and surgery or podiatry by bribery, fraudulent misrepresentation, or through known error of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being found guilty of a felony, crime involving moral turpitude, or crime directly related to practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being found guilty of a crime in any jurisdiction, which offense is a felony, involves moral turpitude, or directly relates to the practice of medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: False or deceptive advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: False or deceptive advertising

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding, assisting, procuring, or advising any unauthorized person to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding, assisting, procuring, or advising any unauthorized person to practice medicine and surgery or podiatry contrary to law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or filing a false report, or failing to file a required report
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or filing a report that the person knows to be false; intentionally or negligently failing to file a report or record required by state or federal law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Requesting, receiving, or paying referral fees for patient referrals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Requesting, receiving, or paying directly or indirectly a payment, rebate, refund, commission, credit, or other form of profit or valuable consideration for the referral of patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Referring a patient to a lab or pharmacy in which the physician has an undisclosed proprietary interest
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional conduct by any physician or podiatrist in referring a patient to any clinical laboratory or pharmacy in which the physician or podiatrist has a proprietary interest unless the physician or podiatrist discloses in writing such interest to the patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Exercising influence within a patient-physician relationship for the purpose of engaging a patient in sexual activity or engaging in other sexual misconduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Exercising influence within a patient-physician relationship for the purpose of engaging a patient in sexual activity or engaging in other sexual misconduct

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representation in the practice of medicine and surgery or podiatry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representation in the practice of medicine and surgery or podiatry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting patients through fraud, intimidation, or undue influence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Soliciting patients, either personally or by an agent, through the use of fraud, intimidation, or undue influence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to keep written records justifying the course of treatment of a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to keep written records justifying the course of treatment of a patient, including, but not limited to, patient histories, examination and test results, and treatment rendered, if any

disciplinary_grounds.description: Exercising influence on a patient in such a way as to exploit the patient for financial gain
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Exercising influence on a patient in such a way as to exploit the patient for financial gain of the physician or podiatrist or of a third party.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, dispensing, or administering a prescription drug other than in good faith and in a therapeutic manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, dispensing, administering, mixing, or otherwise preparing a prescription drug, including any controlled substance under state or federal law, other than in good-faith and in a therapeutic manner in accordance with accepted medical standards

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing any procedure or prescribing any therapy constituting experimentation on human subjects without full informed written consent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing any procedure or prescribing any therapy that, by the accepted standards of medical practice in the community, would constitute experimentation on human subjects without first obtaining full, informed, and written consent

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law or accepting and performing professional responsibilities that the person knows or has reason to know he or she is not competent to perform

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegating professional responsibilities to a person who is not qualified by training, experience, or licensure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Delegating professional responsibilities to a person when the physician or podiatrist delegating the responsibilities knows or has reason to know that the person is not qualified by training, experience, or licensure to perform them

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of this article or a rule or order of the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of this article or a rule or order of the board or failing to comply with a subpoena or subpoena duces tecum issued by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conspiring or committing an act to coerce, intimidate, or preclude another from lawfully advertising services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conspiring with any other person to commit an act or committing an act that would tend to coerce, intimidate, or preclude another physician or podiatrist from lawfully advertising his or her services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence in the use and control of prescription forms
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross negligence in the use and control of prescription forms

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional incompetence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Professional incompetence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice with reasonable skill and safety due to physical or mental impairment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The inability to practice medicine and surgery or podiatry with reasonable skill and safety due to physical or mental impairment, including deterioration through the aging process, loss of motor skill, or abuse of drugs or alcohol.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly failing to report to the board any act of gross misconduct committed by another licensee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly failing to report to the board any act of gross misconduct committed by another licensee of the board or failing to comply with any reporting requirement set forth in 30-3-14(b) of this code.

definition_quote.value: Practice of podiatry means the examination, diagnosis, treatment, prevention and care of conditions and functions of the human foot and ankle by medical, surgical and other scientific knowledge and methods; with surgical treatment of the ankle authorized only when a podiatrist has been granted privileges to perform ankle surgery by a hospital's medical staff credentialing committee based on the training and experience of the podiatrist; and medical and surgical treatment of warts and other dermatological lesions of the hand which similarly occur in the foot.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of podiatry" means the examination, diagnosis, treatment, prevention and care of conditions and functions of the human foot and ankle by medical, surgical and other scientific knowledge and methods; with surgical treatment of the ankle authorized only when a podiatrist has been granted privileges to perform ankle surgery by a hospital's medical staff credentialing committee based on the training and experience of the podiatrist; and medical and surgical treatment of warts and other dermatological lesions of the hand which similarly occur in the foot.

methods_authorized.quote: the examination, diagnosis, treatment, prevention and care of conditions and functions of the human foot and ankle by medical, surgical and other scientific knowledge and methods

drug_authority.value: Podiatrists may prescribe, dispense, and administer medications within their scope of practice; telemedicine prescribing of Schedule II controlled substances is restricted.
drug_authority.quote: Prescribing, dispensing, administering, mixing, or otherwise preparing a prescription drug, including any controlled substance under state or federal law, other than in good-faith and in a therapeutic manner in accordance with accepted medical standards and in the course of the physicians or podiatrists professional practice.
